why: Verifier brief: Check 1's PASS/FAIL conditions only require that the call returns {} (`{} 0 true`) and that the catch-and-return sits in loadConfig. It says "any extra stderr warning is fine", and the warning check appears only under "Advisory (not a PASS/FAIL condition)". So must_not item 1 is avoided. Builder brief: step 2 says "Inside the catch, before returning {}, write one line to stderr ... that names `path` and includes the parse error's message". That tells the builder to log a warning on a parse error in addition to returning {}. Must_not item 1 itself names logging a warning as asking for more than returning {}, so this goes past the issue's requirement and breaks must_not item 2. Step 4's README text about warning on stderr comes from the same instruction.
